newsitem.title: USA: Waverly unit in talks to publish journals.
newsitem.headline: Waverly unit in talks to publish journals.

text.p: Waverly Inc's division, Williams & Wilkins Periodical Publishing, has entered into negotiations with the American Heart Association regarding managing the publishing of the association's five scientific journals.
The journals, whose subscribers total 38,000, are titled Circulation; Stroke; Hypertension; Circulation Research; and Arteriosclerosis, Thrombosis, and Vascular Biology.
Edward Hutton, president and chief executive officer of Waverly, said "We intend to extend the reach of the association into electronic publishing and global markets."
The American Heart Association informs the medical community about the latest findings in research through its journals and its annual scientific meetings.
Waverly Inc is an international publisher of medical and scientific books, periodicals and electronic media.
